msg: Good morning, we are two Belgian divers (both Advanced) staying at a hotel on Isla Grande from the 8th to the 12th. We would like to dive on two different days and do one night dive. We fly home from Cartagena on the 13th at 7 a.m. What do you recommend, and can we pay in euros in cash when we arrive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the reef, and you can do two daytime dives plus one night dive in a single day, then dive again on a separate day.

It includes two daytime dives and one night dive; lunch isn’t included. Hotel pick-up is around 9:30–9:45 a.m. and, if your hotel has boat access, the night-dive pick-up is around 5:30 p.m. You can book the 3-dive day here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-3-dives-already-on-island/22?language=en

Please leave at least **18 hours between your last dive and your flight**. Since you fly at 7 a.m. on the 13th, your last dive would need to finish by 1 p.m. on the 12th at the latest. The daytime dives usually finish around 12–1 p.m., so the team should confirm whether that timing works for your flight.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD

For international guests, payment is **100% by card on the website**; payment in euros cash on arrival isn’t available.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help arrange the two dive days and check the flight timing?
